module: Core of the Vehicle Editor (vehicle editor, static and live modes). The extension also registers itself as the global `vEditor`: it stores there the current vehicle (vEditor.vehicle, vEditor.vdata, vEditor.vehData, vEditor.vehiclePos), the selected nodes/beams and the menus. It automatically loads all `ve*.lua` extensions of the vehicleEditor/, staticEditor/ and liveEditor/ folders, builds the menus from their `menuEntry`/`open`, and emits the `onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams` hook every frame so that debug tools draw with debugDrawer.
usage:
extensions.load("editor_veMain")
editor_veMain.toggleActive() -- enters/exits the Vehicle Editor
local veh = vEditor.vehicle -- player vehicle tracked by the editor
notes: The other editor tools read the state via the global vEditor (rawset(_G, 'vEditor', M)); vEditor.vehiclePos is updated on every onPreRender.

The live/static extensions are discovered by FS:findFiles on the pattern 've*.lua': a new ve*.lua file with menuEntry (string) and open (function) appears automatically in the menu. menuEntry values with '/' create submenus (e.g. 'Other/Crash Tester').
Inconsistency: the module exports `onDeserialize` (without 'd') whereas the extension system calls `onDeserialized`; the editor mode saved by onSerialize is therefore probably not restored.
The 'Mirror Debug' screen is hard-coded into the list of live apps (BeamNGVehicle.mirrorDebugEnabled = true).

onPreRender.desc: Called every frame before rendering. If no vehicle is tracked, initializes vEditor from the player vehicle (be:getPlayerVehicleID(0)). Otherwise updates vEditor.vehiclePos then emits the hook `onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw)`.

onEditorHeadlessChange.desc: Editor hook called when a headless tool is activated/deactivated. If toolName matches the current vehicle editor (vehicleEditorStatic/vehicleEditorLive), prepares the editor (setupEditor) and sets vEditor.editorActive, or removes the 'VehicleEditor' action map.

enabled.desc: true if the tool is activated.

onEditorHeadlessMainMenuBar.desc: Called by the editor in headless mode to draw the menu bar: menus File (Exit Vehicle Editor...), View (Reset Layout) and FPS / GpuWait / Poly indicators.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called when the editor is initialized: adds the 'Vehicle Editor' entry (Vehicles group) to the Window menu.

onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.desc: When the color, colorPalette0 or colorPalette1 field of a BeamNGVehicle is modified in the inspector, converts the color and applies the paint via core_vehicle_partmgmt.setConfigPaints.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Called when the player vehicle changes: reloads the data (vEditor.vehData, vdata, nodeCIDToName, vehicle) for newVehicle.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Called when a vehicle is destroyed: sets vEditor.vehicle, vehData, vdata, nodeCIDToName and vehiclePos back to nil (without checking which vehicle it is).

onSerialize.desc: Serialization before Lua reload: returns {editorMode = vEditor.editorMode}.

onDeserialize.desc: Restores vEditor.editorMode from data.editorMode. Non-standard name (the extension hook is onDeserialized).

saveCurrentWindowLayout.desc: Saves the Vehicle Editor's current window layout via editor_layoutManager.saveCurrentWindowLayout.

toggleActive.desc: Activates the Vehicle Editor if inactive (activates the world editor, the headless mode, loads the apps), otherwise exits it (deactivateEditor(false)) while disabling core_vehicle_manager.setDebug.
